title: BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.23215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated perception in side-scan sonar (SSS) imagery is severely hindered by physical acoustic artifacts, resulting in representations that inextricably mix intrinsic seabed reflectivity with transient viewing geometries. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks rely on augmentations designed for natural images, failing to account for acoustic degradation and explicitly enforce view-invariance. To address this gap, we introduce a physics-informed self-distillation framework built upon the DINOv3 architecture utilizing a ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny backbone to maximize data efficiency. The proposed methodology enforces view-invariance through two primary mechanisms: physically motivated augmentations that simulate speckle noise, range-dependent attenuation, and radiometric miscalibration; and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) penalty that explicitly decouples learned dense patch features from physical viewing parameters. translated_title: BenthicDINO：基于物理信息的自蒸馏方法用于侧扫声呐视角不变表示学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23215v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：侧扫声呐（SSS）图像中的自动感知受到物理声学伪影的严重阻碍，导致表示不可避免地混合了海底固有反射率与瞬态观测几何。现有的自监督学习（SSL）框架依赖于为自然图像设计的增强方法，未能考虑声学退化，也未能明确强制视角不变性。为解决这一差距，我们提出了一种基于物理信息的自蒸馏框架，构建在DINOv3架构之上，采用ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny骨干网络以最大化数据效率。该方法通过两种主要机制强制视角不变性：物理驱动的增强方法，模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射定标误差；以及希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）惩罚项，明确将学习到的密集补丁特征与物理观测参数解耦。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息的自蒸馏框架（BenthicDINO），通过物理模拟增强和HSIC惩罚强制侧扫声呐图像表示的视角不变性，有效解决了声学伪影导致的特征混合问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a physics-informed self-distillation framework (BenthicDINO) that enforces view-invariance in side-scan sonar representations through physically motivated augmentations and an HSIC penalty, addressing acoustic artifact-induced feature entanglement.
